x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: Hazard records represent identified workplace risks that Now Assist can analyze for patterns and recommend controls. Adequate hazard data volume enables AI to surface insights across locations, departments, and hazard categories.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Ensure workplace hazards are logged in the HS module.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Hazard records represent identified workplace risks that Now Assist can analyze for patterns and recommend controls. Adequate hazard data volume enables AI to surface insights across locations, departments, and hazard categories.]]></ai_justification><check_name>HS Hazard Volume</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(){
var ga=new GlideAggregate("sn_hs_rm_hazard");
ga.addAggregate("COUNT");ga.query();
var c=ga.next()?parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")):0;
if(c>=50)return{status:"ready",actualValue:c+" hazards",finding:c+" hazard records found."};
if(c>0)return{status:"needs_attention",actualValue:c+" hazards",finding:c+" hazard records found."};
return{status:"value_blocker",actualValue:"0 hazards",finding:"No hazard records found."};
})()]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>HS</module><number>CHK0003356</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Ensure workplace hazards are logged in the HS module.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 18:41:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>7f6a4539cf214fd48935fb251d851c78</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>HS Hazard Volume</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_7f6a4539cf214fd48935fb251d851c78</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 18:41:03</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
